description: List the profile's own Instagram posts, newest first, as SmartGenius has stored them: the kind, when it went out, its link, the start of its caption, what SmartGenius saw in its pictures (`subjects`) and its `numbers` (reach, saved, shares, likes, comments, totalInteractions, and views for reels) as of `numbersAt`. `numbers` is null for a post whose numbers were never read: they are read for the newest posts, and only while the connection allows it (`canReadInsights` in get_profile). `madeHere` and `postId` mark a post made in SmartGenius. `connected` false means the profile has no working Instagram connection, and the list is empty. `filling` means older posts are still being copied in. Pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` for the next page. It only reads, and asks Instagram nothing.

profile.description: A profile's handle from list_profiles, or its permanent UUID

name: list_media
title: List Instagram posts
